put.summary: Complete conflict resolution for product drafts the current user cannot access due to access layers.
put.description:
For any product drafts in the journey that are inaccessible to the current user due to access layer enforcement, all detected conflicts are automatically resolved. Fields whose policy category matches the configured `productCategory` list take the verified record value; all other conflicted fields take the new (draft) value. If no `productCategory` is supplied, all conflicts default to the new (draft) value.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: ProductConflictResolutionEdit

parameters.name: journeyId
parameters.description: Journey id

parameters.name: X-TENANT-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization

202.description: Success. Inaccessible conflicts resolved (or none existed)

400.description: Bad request. The request has missing/invalid values

401.description: User is not authorized to perform this request

messages.message: Access denied. Following permissions are required: Permission1, Permission2
